$comment: Lab configuration used by 'azd up' (infra/scripts/build_config.py turns it into the Bicep parameters). Mirrors step 0 of the notebook: change models, plans, prices and agents here.

tiers.name: gold
tiers.description: Premium plan: every model, every MCP tool (incl. premium data), the Sourcing Agent, generous limits

tiers.name: silver
tiers.description: Standard plan: cost-efficient models, standard MCP tools, the Sourcing Agent; premium requests are downgraded

tiers.name: bronze
tiers.description: Low-cost plan: nano model only, catalog search tool only, no agents, tight token limits

tiers.name: agent-platform
tiers.description: Internal plan for platform agents: their model and tool calls are charged back to the calling subscription

contentSafety.$comment: Blocked before spend (OFF by default; set enabled to true to deploy it): Azure AI Content Safety screens prompts, MCP tool arguments and A2A tasks at the gateway before any spend (plans opt in with contentSafety: true). The check is charged to the plan $ budget at pricePer1KRecordsUsd per 1,000 text records (1 record = up to 1,000 characters; Prompt Shields analyzes the text a second time), about $0.0008 per call, which makes Silver's $0.01 budget run out a call or two sooner.

purviewDlp.$comment: OPTIONAL Microsoft Purview DLP (Graph processContent on behalf of the signed-in user). Off by default: it needs real Entra users, an app registration with admin-consented Graph permissions, a client secret (PURVIEW_CLIENT_SECRET) and a Purview DLP policy for custom AI apps. See the README.

budgetSuspend.$comment: Over budget, switched off: an Azure Monitor alert on the chargeback records triggers a Logic App that suspends the watched subscriptions when their spend reaches suspendAtPercent of the plan budget.     Off by default. Set enabled=true to deploy it. useCustomRole=true creates a least-privilege custom role at subscription scope, which needs Owner or User Access Administrator; useCustomRole=false assigns the built-in API Management Service Contributor role on the APIM instance instead (the lab's usual Role Based Access Control Administrator is enough).

tools.name: check-inventory
tools.description: Stock level of a SKU per warehouse

tools.name: get-supplier-quote
tools.description: Premium: live supplier quotes for a SKU and quantity

a2aAgents.name: sourcing-agent
a2aAgents.description: Sources a product: searches the catalog, checks stock, gets supplier quotes and recommends a supplier
